summary: Backend-only verification of the Stage-2 NameError fix (advanced_config) plus full SSE council stream. Created /app/backend/tests/test_stage2_advanced_config.py (14 tests, all PASS): signature/static checks, mocked stage1/2/3 + run_full_council unit tests, an in-process ASGI SSE test with OpenRouter mocked that now reaches stage2_complete -> stage3_complete -> title_complete -> complete, and live public-URL regression (health, dev-login, conversation CRUD, stream ': ping' framing + error/refund path with no API key). Existing tests/test_monetization.py: 22/22 PASS. NOTE: I had to repair the environment first — PostgreSQL 15 was DOWN, the postgres password was unset and the llm_council database was missing, so the backend failed startup and the public URL returned Cloudflare 502.

minor.issue: On pipeline failure the SSE 'error' event is emitted but HTTP status stays 200 (expected for SSE); frontend must handle the 'error' event type — verified event contains refunded:true

PostgreSQL is not supervisor-managed: service was down, role password unset, DB llm_council absent. Any container restart loses DB + breaks backend startup (asyncpg InvalidPasswordError). Add postgres to supervisor + idempotent bootstrap (createdb + ALTER USER + migrations).

action_items: None for the reported bug — stage2_collect_rankings(user_query, stage1_results, advanced_config=None) forwards advanced_config to query_models_parallel; no NameError anywhere; both callers (council.run_full_council, main.event_generator) pass advanced_config.
Make PostgreSQL start automatically (supervisor entry or start.sh bootstrap) so the backend does not 502 after a container restart.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/main.py is 882 lines — consider splitting routers (conversations/stream, config, documents) into modules.
stage2_collect_rankings docstring omits the advanced_config arg description (stage1/stage3 document it).
event_generator's broad `except Exception` swallows tracebacks (this is exactly why the NameError was invisible); log traceback.format_exc() to stderr before emitting the SSE error event.
run_with_heartbeat uses a magic tuple marker ('__result__', value) mixed with str yields; a small dataclass/sentinel would be safer if a stage ever returns a 2-tuple starting with that string.
seed_data_creation: Recreated empty llm_council DB (previous data lost with the stopped postgres volume); dev-login user somecedric@gmail.com granted 1000 credits via SQL; a few TEST_ conversations created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Before testing: `service postgresql start`, ensure `ALTER USER postgres WITH PASSWORD 'postgres'` and `createdb llm_council`, then restart backend. pytest-asyncio 1.4.0 installed. OpenRouter must be mocked via monkeypatch on council.query_models_parallel/query_model; for in-process SSE tests load /app/backend/main.py via importlib (a different /app/main.py shadows 'main') and use httpx.ASGITransport with base_url='https://testserver' (session cookie is Secure).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: stage2_collect_rankings referenced advanced_config without declaring it as a parameter -> NameError swallowed by event_generator's except block, so the UI hung after stage2_start. Verified fixed: parameter added and forwarded; council.stage2_collect_rankings.__code__.co_names contains no 'advanced_config' global reference; mocked end-to-end stream now emits stage2_complete/stage3_complete/complete.
